doc.title: Flip Phillips interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 11, 1996

title: Final reflections on the greatest era
summary: He says he played with the greatest musicians in the greatest era of American music and is glad he was part of it.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant

blocks.x: I just kind of cool it, you know?
Well I think you’ve paid your dues.
I think I did. I think I did, yeah.
Well it’s been fascinating talking with you.

In fact I played, my final saying, I played with the greatest musicians in the world, I think, the greatest. All the best. And I did come up in the greatest era of music the United States ever had. And I’m glad I was part of it you know. It was the greatest era I think. If you remember that era.
It’s quite a gift to the whole world.
That’s right. I’m glad I was a part of it. I’ll drink to that.
